item.title: IRPT Holds Missouri Basin Meeting - The Waterways Journal
item.description: Inland Rivers Ports & Terminals (IRPT) held its Missouri River Basin meeting in Jefferson City, Mo., last month. The meeting was held at the Missouri Soybean Association. item.title: On The Move: Holland, Brister, Chia, Leavell, Nadeau, Berry and Donnes - The Waterways Journal
item.description: Colson Holland, C&B Marine Covington, Ky.-based C&B Marine has announced the promotion of Colson Holland to the position of chief financial officer. Holland joined C&B in March 2025 as controller. “Since joining our team last year, Colson has made significant contributions to our financial performance strategic planning,” said Bryan Carlisle, partner. item.title: Serodino Celebrates History, Super Tiger - The Waterways Journal
item.description: Serodino Inc. has been a mainstay of the Chattanooga riverfront and surrounding areas for almost 100 years. Founded in 1933, the company has three divisions. Mid-South Terminals specializes in the transfer of cargo between barge, truck and rail, while Southern Electric Fleet provides fleeting and switching within the Chattanooga harbor on the Tennessee River. item.title: Mini SS Admiral Anchors New Exhibit At St. Louis Museum - The Waterways Journal
item.description: Beginning March 14, the “mini-Admiral” — a 120th-scale steel replica of the historic Mississippi River SS Admiral excursion boat that was based for decades on the St. Louis riverfront — is anchoring a brand-new exhibit at the National Transportation Museum in St. Louis. item.title: C&C Expanding With 24 Acres, Adds Spool Shop - The Waterways Journal
item.description: Belle Chasse, La.-based C&C Marine and Repair, a builder of towboats, tugboats, dredges, offshore supply vessels, barges and other marine craft, has grown its footprint with the addition of 24 acres and the development of a fully automated spool shop.
